translation:
Application for the 2026 College of Engineering Undergraduate Research Internship Pilot Program (Application Period Extended to 29 October)
Posted: 2026-10-20

The Seoul National University College of Engineering is running the "2026 Undergraduate Research Internship Pilot Program" to give undergraduate students the opportunity to experience a real research environment. Interested undergraduate students are asked to apply as described below.

1. Details
(1) Research internship period: (during vacation) Tuesday, 15 December 2026 to Monday, 8 February 2027, 8 weeks
(2) Research internship stipend: KRW 800,000 per student (KRW 400,000 x 2 months)
(3) Eligibility: currently enrolled undergraduate students in years 2 to 4
 - Participation of at least 10 hours per week is mandatory. Students expecting a change in academic status, such as a leave of absence or withdrawal, are excluded.
 - Applicants must be able to complete the Safety and Environment Training (안전환경교육) for the second semester of the 2026 academic year.
※ Students can check their own training completion status through the Research Safety Integrated Information System (신입생연구안전통합정보시스템(SAFE)). Students with earlier student ID numbers should check with the department office.

2. Application Method and Selection Criteria
(1) Deadline and method: Submit the original copies of the documents below (the Undergraduate Research Internship Application and Recommendation Form, and the Safety and Environment Training completion certificate) to Room 319, Building 301 by 18:00 on Thursday, 29 October. (The notice names a staff member as the recipient; contact details are in the original notice.)
 - Form 1 in Attachment 1: Undergraduate Research Internship Application and Recommendation Form ([붙임1] [서식1] 학부생 연구인턴십 지원신청 및 추천서)
 -> Contact the assistant in charge at your preferred lab among those listed in Attachment 2, "2026 Undergraduate Research Internship Pilot Program Research Projects" ([붙임2] 2026학년도 학부생 연구인턴십 시범사업 연구과제), to confirm whether you can participate. Then write your participation plan, obtain the signature of the professor of the participating lab, and submit the form.
 - One copy of the Safety and Environment Training completion certificate (안전환경교육 이수 수료증). (For student IDs from academic year 2024 and earlier (2024학년도 이전 학번), the department will check completion; if the certificate cannot be printed, it need not be submitted.)
※ Observe the deadline strictly, and apply after reading the support plan in Attachment 1 for further details.
※ Our department has been allocated 13 places. If there are more applicants, students will be selected according to the department's selection rules.

3. Points to Note for Participants
- Students will take part in research only after sufficient training on research activities (e.g., precautions during experiments, how to use equipment) has been given.
- Participating students must write and submit Form 2, the Result Report ([서식2] 결과보고서), covering a summary of their research participation, tasks performed, expected outcomes, etc.
- Participating students must complete and submit Form 3, the Research Internship Undergraduate Attendance Sheet ([서식3] 연구인턴십 학부생 출석부).
- Cancellation after selection is not possible, so please consider carefully before applying.

4. Enquiries: the department office (contact details are in the original notice).

** Project proposals added on 22 October (from two professors; names are in the original notice).
*** Project proposal added on 23 October (from one professor; name is in the original notice).

Attachments (2):
- Attachment 2: 2026 Undergraduate Research Internship Pilot Program application – 23 October update (붙임 2. 2026학년도 학부생 연구인턴십 시범사업 신청-10.23 추가.pdf)
- Attachment 1: 2026 College of Engineering Undergraduate Research Internship Program Support Plan (붙임1. 2026년도 공과대학 학부생 연구인턴십 사업 지원계획.hwp)
